name: ate-a-falha
description: Sistema de Gerenciamento de Dietas e Treinos.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ate-a-falha/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @ate-a-falha/database && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev:setup: docker compose up -d --build && npm run dev:db:migrate && npm run dev:db:seed
scripts.dev:db:migrate: docker compose exec api npm run db:migrate -w @ate-a-falha/database
scripts.dev:db:migrate:save: docker compose exec -it api sh -c "cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev"
scripts.dev:db:seed: docker compose exec api npm run db:seed -w @ate-a-falha/database
scripts.dev:db:studio: docker compose exec api npm run db:studio -w @ate-a-falha/database
